changes: A key that answers that it has no credits (OpenAI insufficient_quota / credit_balance_exhausted, Anthropic, DeepSeek, HTTP 402) is left out of routing for 30 min, doubling to 12 h, and CPA's own selector is told to skip it; a request that succeeds on it, or Credits added, puts it back

For a model sign-in accounts serve, API keys and other providers are fallbacks the user turns on under Accounts > Fallbacks, used only after every sign-in account is spent; the usage log no longer keeps a configured key as a record's source

Smart routing covers Codex, Claude and Antigravity sign-in accounts and mixed requests (0.8.0): accounts with quota left come first, then unread sign-in accounts; a spent account is never chosen while another can answer
Accounts gains Claude quota and Antigravity quota views; Auto Review keeps 0.7.1's default route for Codex fallbacks
CPA loads only Provider Manager: CPA Helper, CPA Auto Review, Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok are its parts
Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok accounts are provider-manager auth files with a kind; their models, logins and management routes are unchanged
